reference_title: UFC 3-301-01, Structural Engineering (DoD, dated 11 April 2023, as amended through Change 4, 3 June 2025)
scope_note: Full-manual survey (228 pages). Chapters 1-7 body text extracted (chapter01.json through chapter07.json), using a two-tier granularity: top-level UFC section headers with substantive summaries, plus deeper entries for sections carrying real engineering tables/equations. Appendices A-D and G are implemented as Python lookups (best_practices.py, seismic_force_resisting_systems.py Table B-1, nonstructural_seismic.py, gfrp.py) rather than re-narrated chapter text, matching the em_2104/em_2107 precedent for equation/table-heavy appendix content. Appendix E (Table E-1 live loads) is fully digitized in risk_category_and_loads.py. Table 4-2 (Chapter 4, ASCE 41-17 benchmark-building code-vintage cross-reference) is NOT digitized -- an 18-building-type x 11-code-vintage administrative lookup with no design equations. Appendix F (Composites for Bridging Applications), Appendix H (Glossary), and Appendix I (References) are NOT extracted -- narrow FRP-bridge case-study content, abbreviation definitions, and the source reference list respectively. The figure catalog covers all 13 numbered figures across Chapters 2/3 and Appendix C.
